query: WITH matched AS ( SELECT s.id, similarity(s.normalized_title, $1) AS sim FROM series s WHERE s.normalized_title % $1 UNION ALL SELECT st.series_id, similarity(st.normalized, $1) FROM series_titles st WHERE st.normalized % $1 ), ranked AS ( SELECT m.id, max(m.sim) AS sim FROM matched m GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY sim DESC LIMIT $2 ) SELECT s.id, s.normalized_title, s.content_type AS "content_type: ContentType", s.release_year, r.sim AS "sim!", COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(st.normalized) FROM series_titles st WHERE st.series_id = r.id), '{}') AS "alt_titles!", COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(t.name) FROM series_tags stg JOIN tags t ON t.id = stg.tag_id WHERE stg.series_id = r.id), '{}') AS "tags!", COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(a.name) FROM series_authors sa JOIN authors a ON a.id = sa.author_id WHERE sa.series_id = r.id), '{}') AS "authors!" FROM ranked r JOIN series s ON s.id = r.id ORDER BY r.sim DESC
